cues.text: Some ideas are too interesting to leave in a notes file. Give them a little garden.
cues.caption: A little garden for unfinished thoughts.

cues.text: These are real projects. Scriptorium studies how a text is written. Quillgrain carries its voice.
cues.caption: Scriptorium + Quillgrain
cues.scene: Open the exact English source cards

cues.text: From them, local Gemma grew Echo Cartography: a map of how that voice changes from draft to draft.
cues.caption: Echo Cartography: a new idea takes root.
cues.scene: Show the unchanged genuine Gemma result

cues.text: An editor could use it to spot unwanted changes. Keep the possibility, with both its roots.
cues.caption: A possibility worth keeping.
cues.scene: Keep Echo Cartography and open Collection

cues.text: Other sprouts can become ingredients, too. Here are two earlier discoveries, ready for another turn.
cues.caption: Two earlier discoveries. A fresh direction.
cues.scene: Separate workflow checkpoint: Lexigraph and ClawPulse

cues.text: Send them back to the pile. Their words become new scraps, still connected to the ideas that grew them.
cues.caption: Compost again. Keep the roots.
cues.scene: Click Compost again on both genuine earlier sprouts

cues.text: Nothing is lost. The originals stay, and a new combination can take the idea further.
cues.caption: New ingredients. The same roots.
cues.scene: Show twelve scraps and read a returned idea

cues.text: Your ideas, on your device. A little messy. A little magical. Let your wild ideas ferment.
cues.caption: Let your wild ideas ferment.
cues.scene: Floral closing card with music attribution
